description: Harvard trainer handed over to Sainik School Bhubaneswar by Air Marshal Arjan Singh on 12 September 1964 (plaque), one of the oldest dated IAF display airframes; identity unknown (Harvards were still in service in 1964). Photographed on Google Maps 2020-2023. Source warbirds.in (Jan 2024).
